units.text: It creates, loads, modifies, and saves Excel workbooks using the Workbook and Worksheet classes. It supports cell values and formulas, styling, page setup, data validation, conditional formatting, auto filters, comments, embedded pictures and charts, drawing shapes, and Excel tables (ListObjects). Saving is currently limited to .xlsx.

It reads, writes, and edits Excel workbooks through the Workbook class, which owns a WorksheetCollection of Worksheet objects, and exposes Cells collections of Cell objects for reading and writing string, numeric, boolean, date/time, and formula values.

It applies full cell formatting through the Style class, which controls font, borders, fill, alignment, number format, and protection flags, and supports custom number formats and built-in Excel format codes.

It enforces data validation and applies conditional formatting to worksheet ranges via ValidationCollection and ConditionalFormattingCollection, both scoped to CellArea, supporting whole-number, operator-based, and value-based rules.
It creates charts programmatically and supports drawing objects with preset geometries, while preserving additional chart and shape types loaded from XLSX files verbatim.

It configures print layout and page setup via PageSetup, freezes rows and/or columns by coordinate or cell name, and controls visibility of gridlines, row/column headers, zero values, and right-to-left layout on each worksheet.

It manages cell comments with author, text, visibility, and size via CommentCollection, embeds images from bytes, streams, or file paths with two-cell anchor positioning via PictureCollection, and supports hyperlinks that round-trip through load and save.

This example creates a new workbook, names the first worksheet Report, writes a text value and a formatted numeric value into cells A1 and B1, applies bold formatting and a custom number format to the numeric cell, adjusts row height and column width, and saves the result as report.xlsx.
The library supports data validation and conditional formatting workflows. Example 003 demonstrates adding validation rules and applying conditional formatting to a worksheet.
Create a validation and conditional formatting rule for cells B2 through B11.

The public entry point is org.aspose.cells_foss. The classes below cover the full supported public API surface — 183 public types organized into one module. Interfaces and enumerations are also included.

The org.aspose.cells_foss package provides core classes for reading, writing, and manipulating Excel workbooks, including workbook, worksheet, cell, style, chart, shape, table, validation, conditional formatting, auto-filter, page setup, hyperlink, comment, picture, defined name, document properties, workbook settings, workbook properties, load options, save options, diagnostics, exceptions, and XML mapping utilities.
It adds additional spreadsheet save formats beyond .xlsx, a full formula calculation engine, ChartEx chart type creation, and dedicated enterprise support.
